decision.rationale: Missing keyType reaches a null switch and returns 500. Null-key tests require 400; optional create keys also justify a spec-defect candidate under §10.6.
decision.rule: CODEBOOK_v0.6.md §§9–11.4; §11.4.1(b): deterministic 500 establishes IMPL, but optional create-key spec omission is a §10.6 both_candidate and requires independent review.
decision.verdict_explanation: Independent tests support the response-side 400 error behavior rather than the observed 500. The same tests and a separate @NotNull DTO corroborate required create keys, exposing the spec omission separately. These are compatible obligations, not conflicting intent. Primary IMPL follows R1; both_candidate follows §10.6.
